sourceOriginChain.materializedFrom: MPFB2 HumanService.create_human with macro_detail_dict derived from the tracked Anny reference
sourceOriginChain.derivationNote: Issue #328: the MPFB2 materializer now derives its macro dict from the tracked Anny reference instead of baking the default human. age=0.15 from the measured head-height fraction (0.160, child band — the MPFB age macro has a real child band 0.0-0.1875, so this is a macro CHILD, not a scaled adult); height=0.569 SOLVED by bake-measure-interpolate so the baked+stripped exported body reaches the reference stature (1.25 m). Macros baked into the basis via TargetService.bake_targets immediately after create_human. #317 face keys (32 targets / 13 mouth), #318 helper strip (19,158->13,380 verts / 36,972->26,756 tris), #321 toigo t-shirt fit (2,700 tris, k-NN weighted to the standard rig) and #323 body-part hiding all ran unchanged. Measured (largest non-garment/non-hidden primitive): stature 1.1651 m, chest 0.6237, waist 0.7660, chest:waist ratio 0.8142. The toigo t-shirt was authored for an adult; its fit on the child is expected loose and was not re-graded.
